_about: Keys of «Беги от меня» (Moises keys + strings) written out for the GM-800; generated by tools/jamzone/prep_begi_ot_menya.py notes (edit there, not here). Notes: the MIDI from midifind (parts/begi-midifind.mid) with the record's notes where they differ (stab, arp, pad bars, the lower octave of the lead). C# minor = band key, mix.json bars. Tones and gains are provisional: nothing has been played on the GM-800 or checked by ear yet (2026-11-20). Which voices Alex plays live is not decided: all of them are in the layer for now.
